name: sshi_fbr_filter
rationale: The previous 'sshi_fbr_zener' achieved sufficient average voltage for all conditions (including S2 and S4) but failed on ripple and settling. The ripple is caused by high-current charge pulses inherent to SSHI, while the slow settling is due to the large storage capacitor needed to suppress those pulses when paired with high-impedance loads (like S4's 1M Ohm). I am adding a low-pass RC filter (R_smooth, C_out) after the rectifier. This decouples the energy-collection capacitor (C_res) from the load-smoothing capacitor (C_out). C_res will absorb the SSHI spikes, and the RC filter will deliver a smooth DC voltage to the load, allowing C_out to be small enough for fast settling without sacrificing ripple performance.
